thread:
marta: heads up — canary perf alert for prod-candidate after merge of PR #4821 (fused-attn heuristic). p95 decode increased from ~42ms to 120ms on short-seq workloads. perf-bot posted CI regression at 3739991111.
perf-bot: ALERT: canary-p95 > threshold (42ms -> 120ms) on model x-small (shortseq). CI run: build/4821/canary-4. Details: https://ci.internal/runs/4821
cheng: ack. I saw the same increase on our staging traces ~2hrs ago. Looks like KV cache hit latency spiked too. Curious if kernel selector switched to the new fused path for short sequences.
jyoti: I ran a quick trace. Kernel selector logs show a hot path: "choose_kernel: fused_attention_v2 for sha:cb12" for seq_len<=16 batches of 1. Previously it used "attn_preferred_v1". Also saw extra memcpy in prefetch: app_memcopy 0.9ms -> 3.1ms per request.
liam: can you paste the selector decision snippet? thinking it might mis-evaluate cost model for small batch sizes.
jyoti: here —
```
# kernel_selector.log
[2026-03-18T09:14:02Z] model=x-small seq=12 batch=1 candidate_scores={fused_v2:0.71, attn_v1:0.68} selected=fused_v2
[2026-03-18T09:14:02Z] prefetch.memcopy_us=3120 kv_lookup_us=780 decode_us=7400
```
marta: interesting — scores are close. maybe quant kernel fused_v2 has higher constant overhead that dominates at batch=1.
cheng: I started a bisect locally. git bisect points to commit 5f9b3d4 which landed the fused-attn reorder + an allocator tweak in the same PR. Bisect output:
```
$ git bisect start
good 3739990000
bad 3745020000
5f9b3d4 is first bad commit
```
cheng: when I force the selector to prefer attn_v1 via env override, p95 drops back to ~45ms. So selector decision + fused_v2 constant overhead seems root.
liam: can we reproduce with a minimal harness? i.e., run decode microbench with kv_cache enabled and batch=1 seq=12.
jyoti: did that. Harness numbers:
- attn_v1: avg=38ms p95=46ms
- fused_v2: avg=102ms p95=118ms
KV cache hit ratio ~0.92 in both. So fused_v2 has big extra overhead on small batches.
marta: is the fused_v2 memcpy/alloc pattern different? profiler snapshot shows a stall in gpu memcpy queue and a CPU serialization at serialization.cpp:142
cheng: attaching short flame summary (uploaded to infra — link: https://files.internal/flame/3745029876). Key hotspot: prefetch_memcopy -> cudaMemcpyAsync -> runtime_sync.
deploy-bot: canary rollout paused for model x-small due to p95 breach. Rollout ID: r-2026-03-18-12:canary.
jyoti: hypothesis: fused_v2 relies on larger contiguous workspace and triggers an extra page-lock (cudaHostRegister) for each request when batch==1, causing ~2ms extra memcopy + runtime sync. With batch>8 amortized.
liam: that matches the alloc trace I saw — there is an alloc_host_pinned call per inference in fused_v2 path.
marta: mitigation options: 1) temporary revert of fused-attn selection (set selector bias back) 2) change selector cost model to penalize constant overhead for small batch 3) hotfix in fused_v2 to avoid per-request host register.
cheng: quick mitigation: set ENV KERNEL_SELECTOR_ASSUME_BATCHED=1 to prefer old path for shortseqs. I can push canary config change now. That unblocks customers.
jyoti: prefs: I'd prefer selector tweak + revert as fallback. We should fix fused_v2 host-register path in parallel.
liam: +1. Also add an automated microbench in CI that runs shortseq/batch=1 with KV cache on to catch future regressions.
marta: action items:
- cheng: roll canary config override now (set selector flag) — ETA 15m
- jyoti: open bug for fused_v2 host-register and start patch — ETA EOD
- liam: add failing microbench to perf CI (shortseq+kv+batch=1) — ETA tomorrow
- infra: correlate more traces for other models to ensure not affecting anything else
cheng: started deploy: PATCH: set KERNEL_SELECTOR_PREFER_OLD=1 for rollout r-2026-03-18-12:canary. Rolling back in 2 zones.
jyoti: repro case and bisect gist: https://gists.internal/4821-bisect-logs
marta: thanks. if anyone hits customer-facing errors, ping me and we'll escalate. we should also check dedicated nodes if they have different behavior due to memory pooling.
liam: noted. I'll run dedicated node tests after canary stabilizes.

marta: closing the thread for now — post updates as actions complete. :thumbsup:
